text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-sa~n...! I'm so sorry about 
yesterday~...! I played so terribly~...!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. What we played 
yesterday was a pretty hardcore FPS title, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
If anything, your natural reflexes really 
shone through. I was impressed. You're a 
quick study, so you'll master it in no 
time.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much...! Still, you really 
are amazing, Suzuka-san...!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
She has such wide vision, like she's got 
eyes in the back of her head, and covers 
for you before you even notice...! Always 
calm, without a single wasted movement!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
I want to get better and have even more 
fun with you, Ryoka-san! So—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just once in a while, please 
coach me in games!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...My coaching is a bit strict, you know. 
Are you prepared for it?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well then, shall we get right to 
special training tonight?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Wait, already!? Yay! I get to hang out 
with Ryoka-san~~!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Geez, was that your real goal all along?
